WITH first_innings AS (

  WHERE
    d.inning = 1
  GROUP BY
    m.season
), with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    first_innings_total,
    LAG(first_innings_total) OVER (ORDER BY season) AS prev_total
  FROM first_innings
)
SELECT

  ROUND(CAST(first_innings_total AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_first_innings_total,
  ROUND(CAST((

FROM with_prev
